See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.description: Return item(s) assigned to the specified Punch Item Category ID(s). Retrieve the available Category IDs from the Punch Item Category filter options endpoint.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort the returned Punch Items by. Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter, for example sort=name for A-Z or sort=-created_at for newest first. x-changelog.summary: Add filters[view] parameter to List Punch Items
x-changelog.description: Added support for the filters[view] query parameter on the List Punch Items endpoint. When set to 'my_items', the endpoint returns only punch items associated to the current user (as creator, manager, final approver, or assignee), matching the behavior of the My Items view in the web application.

x-changelog.summary: Remove Punch GPS information
x-changelog.description: Remove latitude, longitude, altitude, horizontal_accuracy, vertical_accuracy keys from Punch Item List response.

x-changelog.summary: Return extended user information for punch_item_manager, closed_by, final_approver, and created_by in List Punch Items response
x-changelog.description: The punch_item_manager, closed_by, final_approver, and created_by fields in the List Punch Items response now return extended user information including company_name.

x-changelog.summary: Add custom field filtering support to List Punch Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports filtering by custom fields using the filters[custom_field_{id}] parameter.
Supports scalar values (boolean, decimal, string) and array values (lov_entries, login_informations) with OR logic.
Example: filters[custom_field_100]=true or filters[custom_field_200][]=10&filters[custom_field_200][]=20

x-changelog.summary: Add comprehensive sorting support to List Punch Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports sorting by 18 fields using the sort parameter.
Supported fields: id, position, name, due, created_at, closed_at, description, priority, workflow_status,
location_name, punch_item_type_name, reference, status_text, trade_name, closed_by, created_by, final_approver, punch_item_manager.
Use sort=field for ascending or sort=-field for descending order.
Example: sort=name (A-Z) or sort=-created_at (newest first)

x-changelog.summary: Add additional attributes to List Punch Items response
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items response now includes additional attributes for better frontend support:
schedule_risk, schedule_risk_reason, due_tomorrow, has_attachments, should_display_risk_flag, and flagged_by association.

x-changelog.summary: Add date range filtering for custom fields
x-changelog.description:
Custom field filters now support date range queries for datetime fields.
Pass a range using the '...' separator (e.g. filters[custom_field_123]=2026-01-01...2026-04-05)
or as an array of two dates (e.g. filters[custom_field_123][]=2026-01-01&filters[custom_field_123][]=2026-04-05).

x-changelog.summary: Support date range and multi-value filtering on the Punch Items list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The Punch Items list endpoint now accepts date range filters supplied as a two-element array
[start, end] for created_at, closed_at, due_date, and date_notified
(e.g. filters[created_at][]=2026-01-01&filters[created_at][]=2026-01-31). The approver_login_information_id,
vendor_id, ball_in_court, assignee_status, and assignee_response filters now also accept arrays of values
in addition to a single value.

x-changelog.summary: Filter Punch Items by custom status
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports filtering by punch item custom status using the
filters[custom_status_id] parameter, which accepts a single id or an array of ids
(e.g. filters[custom_status_id][]=10&filters[custom_status_id][]=20). Ids come from the
Punch Item Custom Status Filter Options endpoint. Filtering by a company default status
returns items resolved to that status whether or not the item carries the id explicitly.

x-changelog.summary: Added custom_status to Punch Item responses
x-changelog.description:
Punch Item responses now carry the item's custom status as a custom_status object with id,
name, default, is_active, legacy_workflow_status, and the global status it rolls up to as
global_status. The flattened list representation (view=flatten_v0) also carries
custom_status_id. The value is resolved, so an item
that has not been assigned a custom status explicitly reports its company's default status
for the item's workflow_status. Both are null for companies without the Punch Item custom
statuses feature enabled. The existing status and workflow_status fields are unchanged.

x-changelog.summary: Add category object to Punch Item responses
x-changelog.description:
Punch Item responses now include a category object with id, name, and active, describing the
Punch Item Category the item is classified under. The object is null for uncategorized Punch
Items. It is returned by the List, Show, Create, Update, Create from Import and
List Deleted (recycle bin) endpoints.

x-changelog.summary: Add filters[category_id] to the Punch Items list endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items, List Punch Item IDs, List Deleted Punch Items and Ecrion PDF generation
endpoints now accept filters[category_id], which returns Punch Items assigned to the given
Punch Item Category ids. Pass the literal value 'none' to return uncategorized Punch Items;
'none' can be combined with Category ids in a single request.

x-changelog.summary: Add category_name to the supported Punch Items sort fields
x-changelog.description:
Supersedes the 2026-04-05 sorting entry. The List Punch Items and List Deleted Punch Items
endpoints now support sorting by 19 fields using the sort parameter.
Supported fields: id, position, name, due, created_at, closed_at, description, priority,
workflow_status, location_name, punch_item_type_name, reference, status_text, trade_name,
category_name, closed_by, created_by, final_approver, punch_item_manager.
Use sort=field for ascending or sort=-field for descending order.
Example: sort=category_name (A-Z by Category name) or sort=-category_name.

x-changelog.description: The punch_item_manager, closed_by, final_approver, and created_by fields in the List Punch Items response now return extended user information including company_name.

x-changelog.summary: Add custom field filtering support to List Punch Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports filtering by custom fields using the filters[custom_field_{id}] parameter.
Supports scalar values (boolean, decimal, string) and array values (lov_entries, login_informations) with OR logic.
Example: filters[custom_field_100]=true or filters[custom_field_200][]=10&filters[custom_field_200][]=20

x-changelog.summary: Add comprehensive sorting support to List Punch Items endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports sorting by 18 fields using the sort parameter.
Supported fields: id, position, name, due, created_at, closed_at, description, priority, workflow_status,
location_name, punch_item_type_name, reference, status_text, trade_name, closed_by, created_by, final_approver, punch_item_manager.
Use sort=field for ascending or sort=-field for descending order.
Example: sort=name (A-Z) or sort=-created_at (newest first)

x-changelog.summary: Add additional attributes to List Punch Items response
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items response now includes additional attributes for better frontend support:
schedule_risk, schedule_risk_reason, due_tomorrow, has_attachments, should_display_risk_flag, and flagged_by association.

x-changelog.summary: Add date range filtering for custom fields
x-changelog.description:
Custom field filters now support date range queries for datetime fields.
Pass a range using the '...' separator (e.g. filters[custom_field_123]=2026-01-01...2026-04-05)
or as an array of two dates (e.g. filters[custom_field_123][]=2026-01-01&filters[custom_field_123][]=2026-04-05).

x-changelog.summary: Support date range and multi-value filtering on the Punch Items list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The Punch Items list endpoint now accepts date range filters supplied as a two-element array
[start, end] for created_at, closed_at, due_date, and date_notified
(e.g. filters[created_at][]=2026-01-01&filters[created_at][]=2026-01-31). The approver_login_information_id,
vendor_id, ball_in_court, assignee_status, and assignee_response filters now also accept arrays of values
in addition to a single value.

x-changelog.summary: Filter Punch Items by custom status
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items endpoint now supports filtering by punch item custom status using the
filters[custom_status_id] parameter, which accepts a single id or an array of ids
(e.g. filters[custom_status_id][]=10&filters[custom_status_id][]=20). Ids come from the
Punch Item Custom Status Filter Options endpoint. Filtering by a company default status
returns items resolved to that status whether or not the item carries the id explicitly.

x-changelog.summary: Added custom_status to Punch Item responses
x-changelog.description:
Punch Item responses now carry the item's custom status as a custom_status object with id,
name, default, is_active, legacy_workflow_status, and the global status it rolls up to as
global_status. The flattened list representation (view=flatten_v0) also carries
custom_status_id. The value is resolved, so an item
that has not been assigned a custom status explicitly reports its company's default status
for the item's workflow_status. Both are null for companies without the Punch Item custom
statuses feature enabled. The existing status and workflow_status fields are unchanged.

x-changelog.summary: Add category object to Punch Item responses
x-changelog.description:
Punch Item responses now include a category object with id, name, and active, describing the
Punch Item Category the item is classified under. The object is null for uncategorized Punch
Items. It is returned by the List, Show, Create, Update, Create from Import and
List Deleted (recycle bin) endpoints.

x-changelog.summary: Add filters[category_id] to the Punch Items list endpoints
x-changelog.description:
The List Punch Items, List Punch Item IDs, List Deleted Punch Items and Ecrion PDF generation
endpoints now accept filters[category_id], which returns Punch Items assigned to the given
Punch Item Category ids. Pass the literal value 'none' to return uncategorized Punch Items;
'none' can be combined with Category ids in a single request.
